definitions.episode_weights: 1/(declared episodes * scope rows in that episode); empty episodes contribute zero
definitions.margin: nearest teacher nonbest minus exact legal minimum; None conditional mean when no alternative support
definitions.pair_mse: sum squared differences of score errors / legal_count**2, partitioned by teacher near-best membership
definitions.phase_weights: full-scope denominator, even when numerator selects initial or postcorrection
definitions.prior_scope: query all-four prior MSE is excluded; it is a distinct population and readout
definitions.seed_means: arithmetic means of all three fits; counts are means, not additional episodes
definitions.strict_witness: exact argmins are separate from actual float32 near-minimum selection

scope: audited retrospective teacher imitation; no new efficacy decision
